data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (From, To, date, Passengers/Class, Confirm, Show flights, Select fare) and names matching parameters. It adds an unneeded Stopover/booking_type option, and it is less precise on the fare choice (it says "cheapest" where the true workflow selects fares per leg), but a browser automation could still be built from it.
